A Inglewood: base linework (CAD preview)

Lines only, one colour per layer; DXF layer names on the right. Frame 1.20 × 1.15 km, takes in the 9 Av SE approach (NW), the Bow (N and E) and the far bank. EPSG:3776, local metres from the red cross (origin -743.53, 5654935.56). Sources: City of Calgary Open Data (assessment parcels, street centrelines, buildings, hydrology, regulatory flood map, tree canopy 2022, Impervious Surface 2021, Tracks – Non-LRT); NRCan HRDEM 1 m DTM (2020 LiDAR). Parcels are assessment parcels, not survey lines. Road edges are the City's 2021 impervious-surface outlines. Canopy outlines under 10 m² dropped. Place labels checked against Esri imagery.

Ground: 1028.2–1048.9 m; contours from the 1 m DTM, lightly smoothed (σ 1.5 m).
